info.title: Business Catalog Service — QuickMobile
info.description:
Business-facing Catalog REST API for QuickMobile. Generated from resolved-ucp.json. Identical structure to UCP catalog-swagger.yaml. Field/path names are business-relevant (renamed) but structure is unchanged. REST binding: flat request body, X-Client-Id header (replaces UCP-Agent). Three operations: searchProducts (POST /products/search), batchFetchProducts (POST /products/batch), getProductDetail (POST /products/detail).
Field name mapping (UCP → Business):
  query         → keyword
  ids           → itemIds
  id            → itemId
  context       → buyerContext
  address_country → country
  language      → preferredLanguage
  currency      → preferredCurrency
  eligibility   → loyaltyTiers
  filters       → productFilters
  categories    → categoryIds
  price         → priceRange  [structure unchanged: {min:int, max:int}]
  pagination    → page
  has_next_page → hasNextPage
  total_count   → totalCount
  list_price_range → originalPriceRange
  media         → images
  alt_text      → altText
  options       → attributes
  values        → choices
  label         → displayName
  selected      → selectedAttributes
  variants      → skus
  rating        → reviewSummary
  scale_max     → scaleMax
  scale_min     → scaleMin
  inputs        → matchedInputs
  available     → inStock
  exists        → inCatalog

post.description: Search for products using keyword and optional filters. Results ordered by relevance. Supports cursor-based pagination. Structure identical to UCP catalog search — only field names differ.

description.plain: Samsung flagship with Snapdragon 8 Elite, 50MP camera, 4000mAh battery.
description.html: Samsung flagship with Snapdragon 8 Elite, 50MP camera, 4000mAh battery.

post.summary: Retrieve products or SKUs by ID (batch)
post.description: Fetch one or more products or SKUs by identifier. Products not found are reported in messages[]. Response may have fewer products than requested IDs. Structure identical to UCP catalog lookup — only field names differ.

post.summary: Get full product detail by ID
post.description: Retrieve complete product information for a single product or SKU. Supports interactive attribute selection via selectedAttributes[] — pass partial selections to get availability signals on remaining attributes. Structure identical to UCP get_product — only field names differ.

200.description: Full product detail or error if not found

description.plain: Samsung flagship with Snapdragon 8 Elite, 50MP camera, 4000mAh battery.

SearchProductsRequest.description: All fields optional. UCP SearchRequest equivalent with business field names.

BatchFetchRequest.description: UCP LookupRequest equivalent with business field names.

GetProductDetailRequest.description: UCP GetProductRequest equivalent with business field names.

selectedAttributes.description: Partial attribute selections for interactive SKU narrowing (UCP: selected)

products.description: Matched products. SKUs carry matchedInputs[] correlation. May be fewer than requested IDs.

BusinessProduct.description: Business equivalent of UCP Product. Identical structure, renamed fields.

DetailBusinessProduct.description: Extends BusinessProduct. Used in getProductDetail response. Adds selectedAttributes[] and overrides attributes.choices with DetailAttributeChoice (carries inStock + inCatalog availability signals). UCP equivalent: DetailProduct.

selectedAttributes.description: Effective attribute selections anchoring the featured SKU (UCP: selected)

attributes.description: Same as BusinessProduct.attributes but choices carry availability signals

BatchFetchProduct.description: Extends BusinessProduct. Used in batchFetch response. SKUs carry matchedInputs[] for lookup correlation. UCP equivalent: LookupProduct.

SKU.description: Business equivalent of UCP Variant. Identical structure, renamed fields.

attributes.description: SelectedAttribute values defining this SKU (UCP: options)

BatchFetchSKU.description: Extends SKU with matchedInputs[] lookup correlation (UCP: LookupVariant with inputs[]).

matchedInputs.description: Maps request IDs to this matched SKU (UCP: inputs)

Description.description: Product/SKU description object (same structure as UCP). NOT a plain string.

Category.description: Category with value and optional taxonomy (same as UCP Category — structure unchanged).

Image.description: Business equivalent of UCP Media. altText renamed from alt_text. No id field.

type.description: Media type (UCP: type). Well-known: image, video

ProductAttribute.description: Business equivalent of UCP ProductOption. values renamed to choices.

choices.description: Available values for this attribute (UCP: values)

DetailProductAttribute.description: Same as ProductAttribute but choices carry availability signals (getProductDetail only).

AttributeChoice.description: Business equivalent of UCP OptionValue. label renamed to displayName. id is optional.

displayName.description: Display text for this choice (UCP: label)

DetailAttributeChoice.description: Extends AttributeChoice with availability signals (getProductDetail response only). UCP: DetailOptionValue.

inStock.description: Whether a SKU matching this choice is purchasable (UCP: available)

inCatalog.description: Whether a SKU matching this choice exists in the catalog (UCP: exists)

SelectedAttribute.description: Business equivalent of UCP SelectedOption. label renamed to displayName.

displayName.description: Selected attribute value display name (UCP: label)

MatchedInput.description: Business equivalent of UCP InputCorrelation. Maps a request ID to its matched SKU.

id.description: Identifier from the batch request that resolved to this SKU (UCP: id)

match.description: How the request ID resolved (UCP: match): exact, featured

amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units (cents). 99900 = $999.00 (UCP: amount)

PriceRange.description: Price range (identical structure to UCP PriceRange).

ProductFilters.description: Business equivalent of UCP SearchFilters. categoryIds renamed from categories. priceRange.min/max are integers (NOT Price objects).

PriceRangeFilter.description: Business equivalent of UCP PriceFilter. min and max are integers (minor units), NOT Price objects.

min.description: Minimum price in ISO 4217 minor units (UCP: min)

max.description: Maximum price in ISO 4217 minor units (UCP: max)

intent.description: Background context for buyer's intent (UCP: intent)

loyaltyTiers.description: Buyer loyalty/eligibility claims in reverse-domain format (UCP: eligibility)

Signals.description: Platform-provided environment signals (same structure as UCP Signals).

Attribution.description: Platform-emitted referral and conversion context (same as UCP Attribution).

ReviewSummary.description: Business equivalent of UCP Rating. scale_max renamed to scaleMax, scale_min to scaleMin.

scaleMax.description: Maximum rating scale value — required (UCP: scale_max)

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from previous response (UCP: cursor)
Cursor to fetch next page (UCP: cursor)

Message.description: Error/warning/info message (same structure as UCP Message).

path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the affected field

messages.content: itemIds must contain at least one entry
